chunks.text: How to refer a candidate on Oracle
chunks.sourceFile: How to Refer a Candidate on Oracle.docx

chunks.text: Log in to Oracle: https://iaaras.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com/fscmUI/faces/FuseWelcome?_afrLoop=2007934363411830&_adf.ctrl-state=1cis2fr6mv_639 and follow these steps:
chunks.sourceFile: How to Refer a Candidate on Oracle.docx

chunks.text: Step 1: In Me navigation à choose Current jobs à move to Step 2
chunks.sourceFile: How to Refer a Candidate on Oracle.docx
How to Refer a Candidate on Oracle.docx

chunks.text: Step 2: You will see Opportunity Marketplace à choose Location tab à choose Location Ho Chi Minh, Viet Nam à move to Step 3
chunks.sourceFile: How to Refer a Candidate on Oracle.docx
How to Refer a Candidate on Oracle.docx

chunks.text: Step 3: you see all the available jobs that are opening in Ho Chi Minh, Viet Nam à click on the job that you want to refer a friend to à move to Step 4
chunks.sourceFile: How to Refer a Candidate on Oracle.docx

chunks.text: Step 4: click the Action box on the front right corner à choose “Refer and Candidate” row and move to Step 5
chunks.sourceFile: How to Refer a Candidate on Oracle.docx
How to Refer a Candidate on Oracle.docx

chunks.text: Step 5: fill in all requirements information then click the Submit button.
chunks.sourceFile: How to Refer a Candidate on Oracle.docx
How to Refer a Candidate on Oracle.docx
